newsitem.title: USA: Microlog unit wins contract renewal.
newsitem.headline: Microlog unit wins contract renewal.

text.p: Microlog Corp said Tuesday its Old Dominion Systems Inc of Maryland subsidiary has won a major contract renewal with The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory which Microlog estimates could be worth as much as $20 million over three years.
The contract is for a base period of one year plus two additional optional years and is dependent upon the specific number and classifications of personnel that are needed during the contract period.

The company said the award represents a continuation of services that Old Dominion has provided to the laboratory since 1992, under the laboratory's prime contract with the U.S. Department of the Navy.
Old Dominion provides software, analytical, and administrative services and hardware support to US prime government contractors.
